summary.text: CRT-639 validates FX Spot moving from FIFO to weighted-average costing for average fill, open P/L, % P/L gross, and realized P/L in cash settlement, driven by associated-data FIFO vs WeightedAvg mapping (CRT-1741) and the formula ladder in CRT-1740/1743/1742/1738. QA proves configuration read, metric ladders (including cross-through-zero paths), and numeric parity across dxTrade5, WebBroker, Adaptive, and API/statement truth sources. Open rounding clarification on XT-7911 remains the main acceptance risk before hard numeric sign-off.
